record.question: Winner of WTA Finals Trophy held in Singapore on 29th October 2017
record.explanation: Answer A: Caroline Wozniacki. Caroline Wozniacki beat Venus Williams 6–4,6–4 to win the 2017 WTA Finals singles title in Singapore on 29 October 2017. WTA’s same-day report records the result. Historical/source note: Singles trophy; WTA Finals also had a separate doubles event. Reference: https://www.wtatennis.com/news/1415425/wozniacki-vanquishes-venus-for-the-first-time-to-win-wta-finals. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
